title: SNACK: A Sequential Notation Framework for Probabilistic Graph Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.19781v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce SNACK, a string representation for probabilistic graph generation that enables sequence models to generate and model graphs with discrete node and edge features. SNACK linearizes graphs by encoding the nonzero entries of the lower-triangular adjacency matrix, establishing a bijective correspondence between valid sequences and ordered adjacency matrices. This design enables invalid logit masking to enforce structural constraints--such as chemical valence and ordering rules--guaranteeing 100% valid generated sequences. SNACK also enables principled string-based GFlowNet training by explicitly accounting for node-ordering symmetries. Across standard graph-generation tasks and molecular distribution-learning benchmarks, SNACK achieves competitive sample quality, while substantially improving the throughput of GFlowNet training relative to graph-based generation. translated_title: SNACK：一种用于概率图生成的序列表示框架
translated_abstract: 我们提出了SNACK，这是一种用于概率图生成的字符串表示方法，使序列模型能够生成并建模具有离散节点和边特征的图。SNACK通过编码下三角邻接矩阵的非零元素来实现图的线性化，在有效序列与有序邻接矩阵之间建立了双射对应关系。这种设计使得无效logit屏蔽成为可能，从而能够强制执行结构约束（如化学价规则和排序规则），保证生成的序列100%有效。SNACK还通过显式考虑节点排序对称性，实现了基于字符串的原则性GFlowNet训练。在标准图生成任务和分子分布学习基准测试中，SNACK取得了具有竞争力的样本质量，同时相对于基于图的生成方法大幅提升了GFlowNet的训练吞吐量。探测分析进一步表明，在SNACK上训练的模型编码了（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: SNACK提出了一种将图线性化为字符串序列的表示框架，通过序列与有序邻接矩阵的双射对应和无效logit屏蔽机制，使序列模型能够以100%有效率生成图，并在保持有竞争力样本质量的同时显著提升GFlowNet训练吞吐量。
en_tdlr: SNACK is a sequential notation framework that linearizes graphs into strings via a bijection with ordered adjacency matrices, enabling sequence models to generate graphs with guaranteed 100% validity through invalid logit masking, while achieving competitive sample quality and substantially faster GFlowNet training than graph-based generation.
